{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the government post of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]|a different [[Minister of War (disambiguation)]]}}
The '''Minister of War''' headed the [[Ministry of War (Alliance)|Ministry of War]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Civil Government]]. In practice, the Minister of War delegated much of the responsibility in running the Ministries to the [[Chief of Staff (Alliance Military)|Chiefs of Staff]], instead focusing of overall strategy and coordination with the other [[Alliance Cabinet/Legends|Cabinet]] Ministers.
